request: the flow of a customer support ticket
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    start[Start] --> sub[Submit Ticket]
    sub --> tri{Ticket Type?}
    tri -->|Technical| tech[Assign to Tech Team]
    tri -->|Billing| bill[Assign to Billing Team]
    tri -->|General| gen[Assign to General Queue]
    tech --> resp[Tech Team Responds]
    bill --> resp[Billing Team Responds]
    gen --> resp[General Team Responds]
    resp --> rev{Resolution Satisfactory?}
    rev -->|Yes| close[Close Ticket]
    rev -->|No| esc[Escalate to Supervisor]
    esc --> resp
    close --> end[End]

request: how a webhook delivery and retry works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    start[Start] --> send[Send webhook request]
    send --> resp{Response received?}
    resp -- "200 OK" --> success[Delivery succeeded]
    success --> end[End]
    resp -- "Error / timeout" --> retry[Schedule retry]
    retry --> backoff[Calculate backoff delay]
    backoff --> inc[Increment attempt count]
    inc --> check{Attempts < max?}
    check -- "Yes" --> wait[Wait backoff delay]
    wait --> send
    check -- "No" --> dead[Move to dead‑letter queue]
    dead --> end
